status: read-only design audit; no loaded content changed
values_status: Qualitative reward targets only. Numerical calibration belongs to the MD mechanics audit.

pairs.a: Larger long-run national revenue and Iraqi operating capacity; temporary marketing disruption and settlement expense.
pairs.b: Earlier reliable receipts and agreed technical investment; smaller continuing Iraqi revenue share.
pairs.conflict: Competing ownership and revenue terms of the same concession.
pairs.join: Engineering, export handling and maintenance; changing the contract later must not stack both shares.

pairs.a: Basic industrial asset plus meaningful efficiency ceiling and engineering benefit; larger initial cost and temporary household burden.
pairs.b: Civilian asset plus consumer-burden relief and quicker production recovery; less heavy-production benefit.
pairs.conflict: Initial capital, imported equipment and skilled-labour allocation.
pairs.join: Shared power and transport, with mutually exclusive priority packages.

pairs.a: Larger mechanization/productivity asset; administrative and capital cost.
pairs.b: Earlier rural-burden relief and cheaper first credit delivery; less initial mechanization scale and subsidy expense.
pairs.conflict: One initial machinery and credit budget, not permanent exclusion of mixed farm ownership.

pairs.a: Concentrated trained reserve/equipment and political reliability; premium pay and ordinary-force opportunity cost.
pairs.b: Broad organization, recovery and staff training; slower training or reduced presidential control.
pairs.conflict: Allocation of modern kit, trained officers and premium pay.
pairs.join: Shared logistics; no simultaneous full Guard and regular priority rewards.
pairs.audit_scope_warning: Do not label nationwide modifiers as Guard-only; verify native formation mechanics before promising a selective effect.

pairs.a: Larger northern settlement relief and regional asset; smaller central revenue retention and real transfer cost.
pairs.b: Larger central oil share with accepted local guarantees; smaller pacification relief and continuing administrative/security bill.
pairs.conflict: Competing fiscal and command terms of one negotiated constitutional contract.
pairs.join: Shared civilian services; failed consent preserves the conflict rather than granting free pacification.

pairs.a: Interoperability, spares saving and genuine Soviet offer; concentrated external dependence.
pairs.b: Second supplier and distinct aircraft/technical capability; cash and mixed-inventory maintenance cost.
pairs.conflict: Subsidized procurement and maintenance priority, not an absolute ban on other trade.

pairs.a: Strong finite opening burst and actual reserve; weaker long-war replacement capacity.
pairs.b: Sustainable replacement production and reserve organization; moderate civilian/research burden and no equivalent initial burst.
pairs.conflict: Forward concentration versus depth and replacement preparation.
pairs.join: Common campaign accounts and reconstruction; actual-war start controls the offensive clock.

pairs.a: Larger consented Gulf liquidity and longer civilian continuity; actual debt and creditor leverage.
pairs.b: Smaller reliable domestic revenue and less external debt; bounded consumer-goods tax/cost and social strain.
pairs.conflict: Financing subsidy priority rather than a ban on mixed tax and borrowing.
pairs.join: Real debt and reconstruction review, orthogonal to operational doctrine.

historical_structure_findings.finding: The common capstone is named Federal Republic even when the player selected autonomy and excluded the federal branch.
historical_structure_findings.proposal: Neutral common settlement capstone that preserves the selected constitution.

historical_structure_findings.finding: The Iran branch's own direct Gulf-credit gateway is placed only under the short-war operational leg. The separate Saddam focus unlocks decision_gulf_credit, whose options call COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unlock_credit, so the long-war route is not universally barred from loans.
historical_structure_findings.proposal: Put the Iran branch's financing priority at a common strategic level, independently of operational doctrine, while preserving the working Saddam gateway.

historical_structure_findings.finding: Party strategy and Aziz strategy repeat the coalition/independence choice.
historical_structure_findings.proposal: One strategic ownership point; distinct Aziz implementation. Front/opposition activity must not require already ruling Iraq.

historical_structure_findings.finding: Both distinct economic themes deliver the same one civilian factory.
historical_structure_findings.proposal: Different programme bundles and role in the economy.

historical_structure_findings.finding: Near-identical nationwide organization rewards do not express concentrated elite versus broadly professional forces.
historical_structure_findings.proposal: Distinct native training/equipment programmes and honest national-scope labels.

guardrails: Preserve January 1970 al-Bakr and actual party/leader gating.
Later 1980s Guard scale, Iranian war, Kuwait invasion and US intervention remain conditional developments.
Kuwait and Khuzestan cores are gameplay counterfactuals, not historical entitlement.
Atrocities, expulsions and environmental destruction are not free productivity or manpower rewards.
Cooperation, loans and autonomy require actual counterpart consent.
Policy reviews replace active priority rewards and never replay one-time assets.
